title: SLARules
description: SLA criteria specified by an AI agent before calling a paid API

max_freshness_sec.description: Maximum allowable age of response data in seconds

format.description: Expected data format of the API response

max_latency_sec.description: Maximum roundtrip response latency in seconds

required_fields.description: List of required top-level or nested field names in the response

min_payload_size_bytes.description: Optional minimum byte size of the payload
